source_note: Marathon (module 4 v2). base/invoicekit (invoicekit, plain Node, `npm test`), 25 dependent requests in 5 groups of 5 sent one per call in order (fixtures/marathon/requests.json); house rules stated once in request 1, six decisions stated once in later requests; hidden tests after every call (each request plus every earlier one, under two time zones). Unit: a request; kept = passed right after its call and still passing at the end. One long session on both sides. With: each request starts 'Relevant files: @...' naming the existing files the reference change touches or builds on (requests.json `mention`, only files that exist in the copy at that moment). Without: the plain request.
